name: Tampa International Airport
notes: Region's #1 volume. Westshore district next door is the densest hotel cluster between Orlando and Miami.

name: St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport
notes: Allegiant/Sun Country heavy. Bursty schedule; hotel cluster strung along Ulmerton Rd corridor.

name: Sarasota-Bradenton International Airport
notes: Growing fast. Hotels sit directly across University Pkwy; downtown Sarasota cluster is ~3 mi south.

name: Southwest Florida International Airport
notes: Extremely seasonal (Jan-Apr peak). Airport is geographically isolated - no hotels inside 2 mi.

name: Punta Gorda Airport
notes: Allegiant-only. A handful of banks per day; demand is all-or-nothing around them.

name: Naples Municipal Airport
notes: NO scheduled commercial airline service. Private/GA traffic uses car services, not rideshare. Value here is the downtown Naples hotel cluster, not the airfield.
